correctness.rationale: Define auxiliary sign a_j=−chi(oddpart(3j+1)) and deficit P(n)=−Σ_{j<n}a_j. The derived four-residue recurrences give P(n)≥1 and characterize P(n)=1 exactly at m_j=(2·4^j+1)/3. A simultaneous strong induction from the stated Q(n)=P(3n)−2P(n) residue recurrences gives Q(n)≤0 for even n, ≤−1 for n≡1 mod4, ≤1 for n≡3 mod4. A prefix Abelian cube would require P(2m)=2P(m) and P(3m)=3P(m); the Q bound forces m=m_j, but P(2m_j)=2j+2 rules all j≥1 out, and m=1 is checked. The congruence 3(i_k+j+1)=2·4^k+3j+1 recovers the first L_k=(4^k−1)/3 auxiliary signs as a genuine paperfolding factor, yielding each local obstruction. Independent checks verified recurrences/absence through over 11,000 prefixes and precise factor matches k=1..6; induction, not checks, proves unboundedness.
residual_risks: Does not prove cubes exist at every starting position or identify the eventual first root if any.
